proposal.rationale: Refined to capture umbrella sections that didn't trigger generic universal phrasing: (1) Short titles for the named acts (Occupational Board Compliance Act, Fresh Start Act, Military Family Freedom Act, Universal Recognition of Occupational Licenses Act) — these are umbrella acts applying to all occupational licensing boards. (2) Section 73-47-3 references "policies provided in this chapter" and is about occupational licensing boards generally. (3) Section 73-47-7 begins "For occupational regulations promulgated by occupational licensing boards" — chapter-wide policy. (4) Section 73-47-9 establishes the Occupational Licensing Review Commission. (5) Section 73-49-1 applies to "all rules and regulations" of any board that licenses health care providers — broad enough for chapter scope. Section 73-47-11 is an exclusion, not a universal application — left undetermined. Section 73-49-3 is profession-specific (lists physicians, dentists, etc.) so deliberately not made universal. Standard cite patterns retained.
